title: About Us – Brückner Maschinenbau
content: The Brückner Group is a family-owned consortium specializing in machine manufacturing and customized engineering solutions and services for the plastics and packaging industry. As a close partner to our customers, we combine innovative spirit and engineering expertise with in-depth market and industry knowledge – for ever improving solutions in the field of film production. We have been able to maintain our pioneering position since 1960, constantly breaking new ground as the world market leader in film stretching technology. With over 1,000 Brückner film stretching lines in operation and a global sales and service network, we are the number 1 in all aspects of film stretching. Since our company was founded, we have built reliable partnerships with our customers and throughout the plastics industry around the world – based on continuity, sustainability and respect.”. We value the long-term partnership and expertise of our suppliers, who consistently set high quality standards with us in the field of film stretching lines.
